experiment: Potential-free Cayley-clique SWAR & coboundary Horizon-2 compilation; exact scalar-trace equivalence and cache-aware ablations

corpus.generator: Fisher-Yates corner/edge permutations; parity correction; constrained independent orientations.
corpus.role: Fresh held-out evaluation seed not used during algorithm prototyping (prototyping used 0x913b5e).

protocol.timing: performance.now around solve; includes input decode and internal verification, excludes table setup and external 54-sticker replay
protocol.statistic: median per instance across 5 repeats, then corpus median and nearest-rank P95
protocol.order: 3-way cyclic rotation (original, contour, dual; 24.59 MiB total < 32 MiB L3 slice) plus separate 2-way interleaved ablations (h2only vs contour; dual vs dual32)
protocol.confidenceInterval: 2000 seeded paired-instance bootstrap resamples; hardware/runtime conditional
